lede: The school board votes Monday on a flood-related budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — real money being shifted because this summer's flooding tore through TIS, TMHS, and the Palm Theatre complex, and that vote on August 25 is the most consequential single action of the week. Alongside it, the Ethics Commission takes up whether to recommend a formal Code of Conduct for Town officials, the County weighs child-care assistance funding and its budget implications, and the Telluride Hospital District board could act on a Two Site Model that would shape what gets built and where for the new medical facility.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-driven budget appropriation affecting district spending this year.
